4mjkEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: A Cosmic Law of Return for Peace, Joy, Prosperity, and Life Beyond Revenge
4mjkEQAAQBAJ.summary: Let Karma Handle It reframes karma as a language of return and balance rather than a threat, superstition, or excuse for passivity. Its practical concern is what happens when a person stops spending attention on revenge, proving, surveillance, and the wish to administer consequences personally. Across themes of betrayal, anger, boundaries, silence, forgiveness, prosperity, joy, and a thirty-day practice map, the book asks the reader to protect conduct and energy without becoming an assistant to punishment.
4mjkEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A reflective practical guide to karma, revenge, betrayal, boundaries, forgiveness, peace, prosperity, and reclaiming energy from the need to punish.
learning: Separate karma from threats, magical thinking, and passive avoidance.
Recognize the attention and energy cost of revenge and constant proof-seeking.
Use boundaries and distance without turning them into punishment theatre.
Distinguish forgiveness from renewed access or denial of harm.
Build a life organized around conduct, peace, joy, and forward movement.
4mjkEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For readers trying to move beyond betrayal, resentment, or revenge without surrendering boundaries or self-respect.

azT2EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Başkalarının Yargılarının Mahkeme Salonundan Nasıl Çıkılır
azT2EQAAQBAJ.summary: Kendini Açıklamayı Bırak, gerekli açıklama, sorumluluk ve onarım ile insanın varlığını sürekli savunma dosyasına çevirmesi arasındaki farkı inceler. Kitap, anlaşılma açlığını, fazla açıklama alışkanlığını, aile rollerini, aşkı, işi, parayı, sosyal medya yargısını, temiz bir 'hayır' demeyi ve sessizliğin güçten doğduğu anları ele alır. Amaç daha az konuşmak değil; her yanlış anlaşılmada kendini mahkemeye çıkarmaktan vazgeçmektir.
azT2EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Fazla açıklama, onay arayışı, sınırlar, temiz hayır, sosyal medya yargısı ve başkalarının fikirleri karşısında özsaygıyı koruma üzerine bir rehber.
learning: Gerekli açıklamayı kompulsif kendini savunmadan ayırmak.
Anlaşılma ihtiyacının ne zaman öz-erimeye dönüştüğünü fark etmek.
İsteksiz dinleyiciler ve bitmeyen tartışmalarda açıklama döngüsünü sonlandırmak.
Aile, aşk, iş ve sosyal medyada daha temiz sınırlar kullanmak.
Sessizliği kaçış olarak değil, gerektiğinde bilinçli bir seçim olarak kurmak.
azT2EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Sürekli yanlış anlaşılmaktan, kendini kanıtlamaktan ve başkalarının yargılarına cevap yetiştirmekten yorulan okurlar için.

28rzEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Sakinliğin Gelmediği Anlar İçin Mindfulness
28rzEQAAQBAJ.summary: Zihnin Ona Ad Vermeden Önce, mindfulness'ı zorla sakinleşmek olarak değil, olay ile zihnin o olaya verdiği isim ve hikâye arasındaki küçük aralığı görebilmek olarak ele alır. Kitap veri ile hikâyeyi, beden sinyallerini, kaygı, öfke, utanç, yas, belirsizlik, bildirimler, dikkat dağınıklığı ve sessizliği inceler. Güvenlik sınırlarını koruyarak okuyucuyu 'isimsiz alan'a, yani tepkinin otomatikleşmeden önce gözlemlenebildiği yere geri çağırır.
28rzEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Olay ile zihnin hikâyesi arasındaki aralığı görmek; kaygı, öfke, beden, belirsizlik, dikkat ve dijital gürültüyle çalışmak için mindfulness rehberi.
learning: Olan şey ile zihin tarafından eklenen yorumları birbirinden ayırmak.
Beden sinyallerini otomatik hikâyeden önce fark etmek.
Kaygı, öfke, utanç ve yasla sakinliği zorlamadan çalışmak.
Bildirimler, mesajlar ve dikkat dağınıklığı karşısında farkındalık geliştirmek.
Kısa geri dönüş protokolleriyle olay ve tepki arasındaki alanı büyütmek.
28rzEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Sakinleşmeye çalıştıkça daha çok zorlanan ve mindfulness'ı günlük hayatın gerçek anlarında kullanmak isteyen okurlar için.

2svzEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Mindfulness para los momentos en que la calma no llega
2svzEQAAQBAJ.summary: Antes de que tu mente le ponga nombre presenta el mindfulness como la capacidad de ver el espacio entre un hecho y la historia que la mente construye sobre él, no como una obligación de sentirse tranquilo. El libro explora cuerpo, memoria, ansiedad, ira, vergüenza, duelo, incertidumbre, silencio, mensajes, notificaciones, aburrimiento y distracción. Su hilo conductor es el «espacio sin nombre»: el instante en que todavía es posible observar antes de convertir una sensación en una identidad, un juicio o una reacción automática.
2svzEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Mindfulness para distinguir hechos de historias mentales y trabajar con ansiedad, ira, cuerpo, incertidumbre, silencio y distracción cuando la calma no llega.
learning: Distinguir lo que ocurrió de la interpretación automática que aparece después.
Reconocer señales corporales antes de que se conviertan en una historia completa.
Trabajar con ansiedad, ira, vergüenza y duelo sin forzar una calma artificial.
Observar el efecto de mensajes, notificaciones y distracción sobre la atención.
Practicar pequeños retornos al espacio anterior al nombre y a la reacción.
2svzEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Para lectores que buscan una práctica de mindfulness realista para momentos en los que la calma no aparece por voluntad.

4zX1EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Verified Bibliography & Authorship Portfolio
4zX1EQAAQBAJ.summary: The Published Works of Faramarz Kowsari is an authorship portfolio designed to make a Persian-language publishing record accessible to international professional readers. It consolidates ISBN-registered publications and records associated with the National Library and Archives of Iran, explains an editorial transparency method for reconstructed English titles and synopses, documents de-duplication by ISBN and record identifiers, preserves author order, and provides verification links where available. The selected edition organizes archival works across technology and AI, business, education, psychology and mindfulness, personal development, relationships, and creative literature.
4zX1EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Verified bibliography and authorship portfolio of Faramarz Kowsari, consolidating Iranian ISBN and National Library records with verification methodology and archival context.
key_topics: National Library and Archives of Iran
learning: Understand the scope and verification method used to assemble the authorship portfolio.
Read reconstructed English synopses as editorial descriptions rather than verbatim publisher abstracts.
Use ISBN and National Library record identifiers to distinguish and verify archival entries.
See how duplicate records and author order are handled in the portfolio.
Navigate a publishing history spanning technology, business, education, psychology, relationships, and literature.
4zX1EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For employers, academic partners, media organizations, professional reviewers, and readers who need an English-accessible overview of Faramarz Kowsari's documented publishing record.

IcrzEQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Mindfulness for the Moments When Calm Does Not Come
IcrzEQAAQBAJ.summary: Before Your Mind Names It treats mindfulness as the ability to notice the interval between an event and the name, judgment, or story the mind gives it. Rather than demanding calm, the book works with body signals, memory, anxiety, anger, shame, grief, uncertainty, silence, messages, notifications, boredom, distraction, and the temptation to use meditation as escape. Its recurring practice is to return to the unnamed space where experience can be observed before reaction becomes identity.
IcrzEQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical mindfulness guide to the space between experience and interpretation, covering body awareness, anxiety, anger, uncertainty, digital distraction, and return practices.
learning: Separate observable events from the stories and labels that rapidly follow them.
Notice body signals before they are absorbed into automatic interpretations.
Work with anxiety, anger, shame, grief, and uncertainty without forcing calm.
Recognize when meditation or distraction is being used to avoid experience.
Use short return practices to widen the space between stimulus and response.
IcrzEQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For readers who want mindfulness that remains usable during emotionally noisy moments rather than only when calm is already present.

VYn1EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: A Visual, Practical Guide with Real Business Projects, Interview Problems, CTEs, Window Functions, Dashboards, and Portfolio Workflows
VYn1EQAAQBAJ.summary: SQL for Data Analysis is a visual, practice-oriented path from relational foundations to portfolio-ready analytics. It covers database structure, schema design, SELECT queries, filtering, sorting, joins, aggregation, data types, import and export, constraints and integrity, DDL and DML, transactions, CTEs, subqueries, views, temporary logic, window functions, ranking, interview problems, projects, optimization, and business interpretation. The book is dialect-aware and repeatedly emphasizes safe execution: destructive statements are tested in controlled environments, rows are verified, transactions are used, and SELECT comes before change.
VYn1EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A visual SQL guide from relational foundations and joins to CTEs, window functions, interview problems, business projects, optimization, dashboards, and portfolio work.
learning: Build a reliable relational foundation with tables, keys, schemas, and relationships.
Write clean queries using filtering, sorting, joins, grouping, aggregation, CTEs, and windows.
Handle data types, imports, constraints, integrity, DDL, DML, and transactions safely.
Interpret query results as business evidence rather than stopping at syntax.
Practice interview patterns, real projects, optimization, and portfolio delivery across SQL dialects.
VYn1EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For aspiring data analysts, data scientists, business analysts, and developers who want practical SQL skills tied to real analytical work.

ITT2EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: How to Leave the Courtroom of Other People's Opinions
ITT2EQAAQBAJ.summary: Stop Explaining Yourself examines the difference between responsible explanation and compulsive self-defense. It follows the urge to be understood through family roles, relationships, work, money, social media, boundaries, and the endless internal courtroom where every choice seems to require a case. The book does not argue for silence or avoidance of accountability; it asks when explanation stops clarifying and starts erasing the person who is explaining.
ITT2EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: A practical guide to over-explaining, approval seeking, boundaries, clean refusals, social judgment, and leaving the courtroom of other people's opinions.
learning: Distinguish useful explanation from compulsive self-justification.
Recognize when the hunger to be understood becomes self-erasure.
Stop feeding arguments with people who are unwilling to listen in good faith.
Use cleaner boundaries in family, love, work, and online spaces.
Choose silence deliberately when more explanation would not create clarity.
ITT2EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: For readers exhausted by proving, defending, and translating themselves to people whose judgment has become an internal courtroom.

YzT2EQAAQBAJ.subtitle: Cómo salir del tribunal de las opiniones ajenas
YzT2EQAAQBAJ.summary: Deja de explicarte examina la diferencia entre una explicación necesaria y la defensa compulsiva de la propia existencia. El libro sigue la necesidad de ser comprendido a través de la familia, el amor, el trabajo, el dinero, las redes sociales, los límites y el hábito de convertir cada decisión en un expediente. No propone dejar de asumir responsabilidades; propone reconocer cuándo explicar aclara y cuándo solo prolonga un juicio que no terminará con más palabras.
YzT2EQAAQBAJ.seo_description: Guía práctica sobre sobreexplicación, necesidad de aprobación, límites, redes sociales y cómo salir del tribunal de las opiniones ajenas.
learning: Distinguir una explicación útil de una justificación compulsiva.
Reconocer cuándo la necesidad de ser comprendido termina borrando la propia posición.
Dejar de alimentar discusiones con oyentes que no buscan comprender.
Usar límites más limpios en familia, amor, trabajo y espacios digitales.
Elegir el silencio cuando añadir palabras ya no añade claridad.
YzT2EQAAQBAJ.target_audience: Para personas cansadas de justificarse, demostrar su valor y vivir pendientes de la opinión ajena.
